data.title: Firms back growth push
data.description: Thailand's leading corporations have joined forces with government agencies to establish 928 district-based social enterprise companies nationwide, aiming to strengthen local economies and create lasting social impact during the country's two auspicious royal years in 2026 and 2027.

data.title: India activists demand release of detained 'cockroach' protesters
data.description: NEW DELHI - India's youth-led "cockroach" movement, whose nationwide protests forced the resignation of the education minister, urged authorities on Monday to release all detained demonstrators.

data.title: HIV progress in 'real danger' as global funding plummets
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - The science has never been better, but political will has reached a new low: AIDS experts warned Monday that the fight against HIV was in real danger as funding fell by a fifth last year.

data.title: Three Indian abductees rescued after being lured to Pattaya and tortured
data.description: PATTAYA: Police rescued three Indian men after they had been held for ransom by a scam gang that lured them from their homeland to Pattaya with a cheap tour package and tortured them for a week.

data.title: China charges alleged scam kingpin Chen Zhi with intentional injury
data.description: SHANGHAI — Alleged scam-network mastermind Chen Zhi could face the death penalty, with Chinese prosecutors adding intentional injury to the list of charges against him.

data.title: Building collapses during demolition for Orange Line project
data.description: A five-storey building collapsed during demolition work to make way for the Orange Line electric train system in Din Daeng district, Bangkok, on Monday evening.

data.title: Heat, overcrowding, pushes Italian prison guard union to sue
data.description: ROME — A prison guard union in Italy's southern Puglia region will ask prosecutors to investigate widespread workplace safety abuses, with temperatures inside overcrowded prisons rising above 50°C, in a case the union says is a first, Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) has learned.

data.title: Spain races to contain blazes before new heatwave
data.description: NAVALUENGA (SPAIN) - Spain has two crucial days in front of it to bring wildfires under control before weather conditions worsen, authorities said Monday, as Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called on citizens to "exercise extreme caution" ahead of a new heatwave.

data.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa calls for African action on migration
data.description: MIDRAND — South African President Cyril Ramaphosa called on Monday for African countries to work together to manage migration, as his government faces mounting pressure over attacks on foreign nationals.

data.title: Former Thai tennis player found dead with signs of assault
data.description: Police are investigating the death of Natthawee Sukantharun, better known as “Coach Nat,” a former Thai national tennis and beach-tennis player who was found dead at his home in Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri province, on Sunday.

data.title: Malaysia detains over 100 Rohingya refugees seeking shelter at UNHCR
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR, July 27 (Reuters) - Malaysian authorities detained more than 100 Rohingya Muslim asylum seekers on Monday who had gathered outside the United Nations (UN) refugee agency in Kuala Lumpur, saying they were seeking protection after being evicted from their homes.

data.title: Malaysia PM orders action against Rohingya Muslims gathered in front of UN refugee agency
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR — Malaysian ⁠Prime ⁠Minister Anwar Ibrahim on Monday ​ordered enforcement agencies to take action against a group of Rohingya Muslim ​refugees that had gathered in front ‌of the office of the United Nations (UN) refugee agency in Kuala Lumpur, saying those without proper permits would be detained.

data.title: Infantino slams World Cup critics for 'spreading hate'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino has hit back at World Cup critics, claiming they were "spreading hate and false rumours" and arguing the tournament delivered "only joy and happiness".

data.title: Cabinet eases criteria for welfare card recipients
data.description: The cabinet has approved revised eligibility criteria for the State Welfare Card, allowing about 9.3 million rejected applicants to appeal and possibly be approved.

data.description: Police are investigating the death of Natthawee Sukantharun, better known as “Coach Nat”, a former Thai national tennis and beach tennis player who was found dead at his home in Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri, on Sunday.

data.title: Two senior officials face charges in civil service exam rigging scandal
data.description: Two high-level officials have been summoned to hear police charges in relation to the rigging of results of the civil service recruitment examination for local government bodies nationwide.

data.title: Indonesia's Prabowo approval rating drops to 51.1%, survey finds
data.description: JAKARTA - The approval ⁠rating ⁠of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto ​fell to 51.1% in July 2026, a poll showed, with respondents pointing to the ​state of the country's economy more ‌than a year and a half into his term of office.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ryujin Nasukawa enters Di Bella’s orbit with statement debut TKO
data.description: Ryujin Nasukawa’s statement debut TKO has added a compelling new name to ONE Championship’s strawweight kickboxing title picture – and a future clash with Jonathan Di Bella already appears inevitable if the Japanese prospect continues his rapid rise.

data.title: Making smoking cool again? Pop culture glamoriizes cigarettes
data.description: NEW YORK — From beauty mogul Kylie Jenner lighting up on the cover of Vanity Fair to cigarette trays at singer Dua Lipa's wedding, the pop culture-verse has rebooted cigarettes as the accessory du jour, health risks be damned.

data.title: Have your mooncake and eat it, too!
data.description: It’s that time of the year when the moon is at its fullest and brightest, according to ancient Chinese belief. The Mid-Autumn Festival or Moon Festival is celebrated on the 15th day of the eighth month of the lunar calendar or Oct 6 this year.

data.title: GMMTV backlash mounts over fan-security guards clash
data.description: A confrontation between a Chinese fan and security personnel at the International Novel Festival 2026 has sparked widespread criticism of the organiser, Thai entertainment giant GMMTV, which felt compelled to issue an explanatory statement on Monday.

data.title: Chinese shop owner skimmed compatriots’ credit cards, stole B30m
data.description: A Chinese man and three Thais have been arrested for allegedly skimming the credit card data of 1,200 Chinese visitors to their shops in Bangkok and Chiang Mai and stealing 30-million-baht from them using forged credit cards.
